chapter: 第二编 电动力学基础
title: Fields of a Uniformly Charged Sphere and an Infinite Plane
printed_title: 70. 均匀带电球面和无限大平面的场强

prose.text: Nature and engineering contain many spherical or nearly spherical objects, such as stars, planets, and raindrops, as well as approximately flat surfaces. A small region of a curved surface can also be approximated as a plane when the scale being considered is sufficiently small.
prose.source_text: 在自然界和工程技术中，有很多球形或接近球形的物体(恒星、行星、雨滴等)，也有不少是平面物体. 此外，任何表面的很小一段，也可以近似看作为平面.

prose.text:
**The field of a spherical surface** Consider an isolated metal sphere of radius $R_0$. With no applied external field and a homogeneous surrounding medium, its charge is uniformly distributed over the surface at electrostatic equilibrium. The external field lines follow radial directions;
Figure 125 illustrates this structure for a positively charged sphere.
prose.source_text: **球面的电场** 电荷在半径为$R_0$的金属球面上的分布是均匀的. 球面的电力线是沿着球的半径的延长线(图125).

prose.text:
Here r is the distance from the center of the sphere to the observation point. Outside the sphere, the field-line pattern is the same as that of a point charge at the center with the same total charge, as shown in Figure 126. A matching line pattern alone does not determine field magnitude: the same total charge and spherical symmetry are also needed. In a homogeneous surrounding medium, the external field is therefore given by the point-charge formula (8-13). The source writes $r\geq R_0$;
at the surface, the following expression means the limiting field approached from outside. In SI units,
prose.source_text: 请注意：球外面电力线的分布跟点电荷电力线的分布是完全一样的(图126). 如果电力线的分布一致，则场强也应当一致. 因此，距球心 $r\geq R_0$ 处的场强，也用放在球心处的点电荷场强公式(8-13)来确定. 在国际单位制中，

prose.text: Figure 125
prose.label: 图125

prose.text: Figure 126
prose.label: 图126

prose.text: $E=\frac{|q|}{4\pi\varepsilon_0\varepsilon r^2}$. (8-16)

At electrostatic equilibrium, the field inside the metal sphere, where $r<R_0$, is zero. The permittivity factors in the preceding formula are the vacuum permittivity and the relative permittivity of the surrounding medium, respectively.
prose.source_text: 金属球内部($r<R_0$)的场强等于零.

prose.text:
**The field of a plane** Equal areas of a uniformly charged surface carry equal charges. The source describes this uniformity using the charge per square centimeter;
charge per unit area is called the surface charge density $\sigma$. If charge $q$ is uniformly distributed over area $S$, then
prose.source_text: **平面的电场** 设每平方厘米表面**带有相同的电荷** $\sigma$. 于是，表面是均匀带电表面. 单位面积所带的电荷，叫做电荷的面密度. 如果电荷 $q$ 均匀地分布在面积 $S$ 上，则

prose.text: $\sigma=\frac{q}{S}$. (8-17)

Consider an ideal infinite, uniformly charged thin plane with the same homogeneous medium on both sides. Its field lines are parallel and perpendicular to the plane, as shown in Figure 127. The field is uniform within each half-space, and its magnitude is independent of distance from the plane. The magnitudes on the two sides are equal, but the directions are opposite. Lines point away from positive charge and toward negative charge. The magnitude is determined by the surface charge density $\sigma$.
prose.source_text: 无限大均匀带电平面的电力线是彼此平行的，且垂直于平面(图127).无限大平面的电场是匀强电场，即空间中的所有点的场强都是相同的，与到平面的距离无关. 它的量值由 $\sigma$ 来确定.

prose.text:
For a sphere or point charge, the charge-and-distance dependence is represented by $q/r^2$;
for an infinite plane, field magnitude is proportional to the absolute value of the surface charge density $\sigma$. Calculation for the ideal model described above gives the following results.
prose.source_text: 跟球面或点电荷的场强与 $q/r^2$ 成正比相类似，平面的场强与 $\sigma$ 成正比. 根据计算求出比例系数，得出下列结果：

prose.text: Figure 127
prose.label: 图127

prose.text: In SI units, with surface charge density measured in coulombs per square meter,
$E=\frac{|\sigma|}{2\varepsilon_0\varepsilon}$. (8-18)

In the electrostatic unit system used by the source, use that system throughout for charge density and field strength;
do not substitute SI numerical values directly,
$E=\frac{2\pi|\sigma|}{\varepsilon}$. (8-19)

No real plane is infinite. For a finite uniformly charged plane, the infinite-plane result is a useful approximation when the observation point is well away from the edges and its distance from the plane is much smaller than the lateral dimensions of the plane. The approximation does not apply near an edge. Contributions from small charged regions decrease with the inverse square of distance, so distant edge regions have a smaller influence at the point being considered.
prose.source_text: 无限大的平面是没有的. 但是，如果平面的尺寸与从某点到它的距离相比是很大的，则该点的场强实际上是和无限大平面在该点所产生的场强是一样的. 由于很小的单位电荷的场强与距离的平方成反比，所以，平面边缘部分对场强的影响是很小的.

prose.text: 在自然界和工程技术中，有很多球形或接近球形的物体(恒星、行星、雨滴等)，也有不少是平面物体. 此外，任何表面的很小一段，也可以近似看作为平面.
**球面的电场** 电荷在半径为$R_0$的金属球面上的分布是均匀的. 球面的电力线是沿着球的半径的延长线(图125).
请注意：球外面电力线的分布跟点电荷电力线的分布是完全一样的(图126). 如果电力线的分布一致，则场强也应当一致. 因此，距球心 $r\geq R_0$ 处的场强，也用放在球心处的点电荷场强公式(8-13)来确定. 在国际单位制中，
$E=\frac{|q|}{4\pi\varepsilon_0\varepsilon r^2}$. (8-16)
金属球内部($r<R_0$)的场强等于零.
**平面的电场** 设每平方厘米表面**带有相同的电荷** $\sigma$. 于是，表面是均匀带电表面. 单位面积所带的电荷，叫做电荷的面密度. 如果电荷 $q$ 均匀地分布在面积 $S$ 上，则
$\sigma=\frac{q}{S}$. (8-17)
无限大均匀带电平面的电力线是彼此平行的，且垂直于平面(图127).无限大平面的电场是匀强电场，即空间中的所有点的场强都是相同的，与到平面的距离无关. 它的量值由 $\sigma$ 来确定.
跟球面或点电荷的场强与 $q/r^2$ 成正比相类似，平面的场强与 $\sigma$ 成正比. 根据计算求出比例系数，得出下列结果：
在国际单位制中，
$E=\frac{|\sigma|}{2\varepsilon_0\varepsilon}$， (8-18)
在静电单位制中，
$E=\frac{2\pi|\sigma|}{\varepsilon}$. (8-19)
无限大的平面是没有的. 但是，如果平面的尺寸与从某点到它的距离相比是很大的，则该点的场强实际上是和无限大平面在该点所产生的场强是一样的. 由于很小的单位电荷的场强与距离的平方成反比，所以，平面边缘部分对场强的影响是很小的.
